    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    heights = list(map(int, data[1:]))

    for i in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
        while heights[i] >= heights[i - 1] + 2:
            diff = min(heights[i] - heights[i - 1] - 1, heights[i] - heights[i - 1])
            heights[i] -= diff
            heights[i - 1] += diff

    print(" ".join(map(str, heights)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
